entry.value: import knime.scripting.io as knio%%00010import pandas as pd%%00010import numpy as np%%00010%%00010# Load dataset from KNIME input port%%00010df = knio.input_tables[0].to_pandas()%%00010%%00010def get_leading_digit(val):%%00010 try:%%00010 # Benford's law applies to the absolute magnitude of the number%%00010 v = abs(float(val))%%00010 if v == 0 or pd.isna(v):%%00010 return None%%00010 %%00010 # Convert to string, strip decimal points and leading zeros, grab the first character%%00010 digit = str(v).replace('.', '').lstrip('0')[0]%%00010 if digit.isdigit() and 1 <= int(digit) <= 9:%%00010 return int(digit)%%00010 return None%%00010 except:%%00010 return None%%00010%%00010# Create a copy and extract the leading digit for every row%%00010df_details = df.copy()%%00010df_details['Leading_Digit'] = df_details['Amount'].apply(get_leading_digit)%%00010%%00010# Filter out rows without a valid leading digit (e.g., exactly 0.00)%%00010df_analysis = df_details.dropna(subset=['Leading_Digit'])%%00010total_count = len(df_analysis)%%00010%%00010# Calculate Actual Frequencies%%00010actual_counts = df_analysis['Leading_Digit'].value_counts().sort_index()%%00010%%00010results = []%%00010for digit in range(1, 10):%%00010 count = actual_counts.get(digit, 0)%%00010 %%00010 # Actual percentage distribution%%00010 actual_pct = (count / total_count) * 100 if total_count > 0 else 0%%00010 %%00010 # Expected Benford's Law distribution formula: log10(1 + 1/d)%%00010 expected_pct = np.log10(1 + 1/digit) * 100%%00010 %%00010 # Variance (Positive = overrepresented, Negative = underrepresented)%%00010 variance = actual_pct - expected_pct%%00010 %%00010 results.append({%%00010 'Leading_Digit': str(digit),%%00010 'Actual_Count': count,%%00010 'Actual_Percentage': round(actual_pct, 2),%%00010 'Expected_Percentage': round(expected_pct, 2),%%00010 'Variance_Percentage': round(variance, 2)%%00010 })%%00010%%00010# Output Port 0: The Benford Summary Table%%00010df_summary = pd.DataFrame(results)%%00010knio.output_tables[0] = knio.Table.from_pandas(df_summary)%%00010%%00010# Output Port 1: The Original Data with the 'Leading_Digit' appended %%00010# (Only works if you add a second output port to the KNIME node, useful for drilling down into anomalies)%%00010if len(knio.output_tables) > 1:%%00010 knio.output_tables[1] = knio.Table.from_pandas(df_details)
